rationale: Retain one active Jupiter Power platform and correct its evidence, dates, operating scale and BlackRock/GIP attribution. BlackRock's legacy Diversified Infrastructure business announced the acquisition from EnCap, Yorktown and Mercuria on November 15, 2022 and transaction records show the acquisition closed on December 21, 2022. Current Jupiter materials use GIP-backed branding after BlackRock's upstream acquisition of GIP, but no asset-level transfer, second vehicle or separate GIP ownership period was found. The current platform develops, owns and operates utility-scale battery storage across U.S. power markets, and no later sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 23, 2026.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Jupiter Power LLC is a U.S. utility-scale battery-energy-storage platform that develops, owns and operates BESS projects serving energy, capacity and ancillary-services markets. Current company materials report 8,800 MWh operating, under construction or under contract and more than 20,000 MW in active development across eight U.S. RTO/ISO markets. BlackRock's legacy Diversified Infrastructure business announced the acquisition of Jupiter from EnCap Investments and co-investors Yorktown Partners and Mercuria Energy on November 15, 2022, and the acquisition closed on December 21, 2022. Jupiter now uses GIP-backed branding following BlackRock's October 2024 acquisition of GIP, but no separate Jupiter asset transfer or second GIP ownership period was disclosed. Austin, Houston and Chicago are disclosed office hubs; a single legal headquarters is not publicly disclosed. No later company sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 23, 2026.
